transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling incredibly down and depressed lately. It has been going on for about a month now, and I just feel this constant, heavy sadness that I can't seem to shake.

Have you ever had a period lasting several days or more when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual? This would help me know whether these low moods might be part of bipolar disorder rather than depression alone.

No, I've never had times where I felt unusually energetic or euphoric like that, or felt like I didn't need sleep. My main struggle has really just been this heavy, low mood that I can't seem to get out of.
Before this past month, have you been feeling down most days for at least the last two years, or did this start after a specific stressful event or major change in your life?

No, I haven't been feeling this way for two years; this really just started about a month ago. I also can't think of any specific stressful event or major change in my life that might have triggered it.
Along with feeling down, have you also noticed changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, enjoyment of things, or feelings of guilt or worthlessness?

Yes, I've really struggled to concentrate on anything lately, and I've completely lost interest and enjoyment in the things I used to love. I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep, appetite, or feelings of guilt, though.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?

Yes, I frequently have thoughts of wanting to die, and I often just wish I wouldn't wake up in the morning. I've also felt these sudden, scary urges to end my life, and I've even started thinking about specific ways to actually do it.
Have you made any specific plan for how you would end your life, and do you have access to the things you would use?

Yes, I have started making specific plans in my head about when, where, and how I would do it. I haven't actually gathered any materials or gotten access to anything yet, but the scenarios of how to end my life are very clear in my mind.
When you’re feeling this depressed, have you heard or seen things other people don’t, or strongly believed things like being guilty, worthless, or beyond help in a way others say isn’t true?

Yes, when I am feeling this deeply depressed, I sometimes hear whispering voices and see shadows when no one is there. I also get this overwhelming feeling that my body is somehow shutting down or decaying, but these strange experiences only happen when my mood is at its very lowest.
Do the voices or beliefs mostly fit with your depression, like telling you that you’re worthless, guilty, or that your body is failing, or do they ever seem unrelated to your mood?

Yes, they definitely fit with how awful I feel, often making me believe my body is failing or that people are constantly watching and judging me. These voices and beliefs only happen when I am deeply depressed, and they completely go away if my mood lifts even a little.
